phases.dialogueLine: Down here, everything answers to someone. Even me.

check.name: The Undertow
check.telegraph: He circles fast and low and the whole drowned court fires down the whirlpool at once, a wall of iron closing on your hull.
check.hint: No brace holds against a wall this wide. Raise a shield to break it, or out-heal what gets through.
check.counteredLine: The barrage breaks on your crew’s answer in a wall of spray.
check.failLine: The undertow drags your broadside off true, and the court’s iron rakes you while your guns swing wild.

phases.dialogueLine: Sink me if you can. The mission goes on WITHOUT me.

check.name: The Last Bite
check.telegraph: The megalodon rears his whole bulk from the water for one final lunge. And for one breath his throat hangs open above your deck.
check.hint: The throat hangs open for one breath. Fire everything down it with a big shot, or throw up a brace or shield and ride out the lunge.
check.counteredLine: Your crew fires straight down his throat and the last bite dies in the water.
check.failLine: The last bite comes down, and the deep finally closes over you.

preFightDialogue.speaker: narrator
preFightDialogue.text: Past the thrown gates the water goes still and black, and the Don's flagship sits at anchor in the middle of it.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: You've done well. But let it go down in the history books that this is your last stop.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: We're rewriting history as we speak. The Finndicate falls today.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Why do you call yourself the Don? And then sign your oldest orders with an "F".

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: As if you didn't know me as Don Finleone.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: It's not quite right to go by multiple names like that.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: You speak as if you know any better. There's nothing you can do at this point. Our mission proceeds no matter what! And you fools don't know what you've gotten yourself into.

preFightDialogue.speaker: narrator
preFightDialogue.text: The blockade line rides the swell ahead, lanterns out, gunports open. At its center, Sal Brackwater's hull awaits.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: No further, captain.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Long way from home, Sal. Who's watching the Don's back now?

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: As long as I'm around, the Don need not worry about his back.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Then step aside. We've got business with him.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: No business comes to the Don except through me.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: I'll be happy to cut straight through you!

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: I remember you...Mira. Looks like you made some new friends after I took care of your old ones.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Why you...

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Skip the pleasantries. I have a dinner with the Don this evening.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: So full of yourself. But we're hungry to take you down.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: ...so Doby just gets a free pass to say that? No one else thinks that was lame?

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: I've been looking forward to destroying you lot.

phases.dialogueLine: The don said bring him your colors. He never said in one piece.

check.name: The Death Roll
check.telegraph: Sal takes your hull in his teeth, sets his feet against the swell, and starts to turn.
check.hint: He is going to roll, and he will not let go. Only a crew ability gets something between your hull and that grip. Your own brace or dodge does nothing here.
check.counteredLine: He rolls against braced timber, tears off a mouthful of nothing, and lets go spitting splinters.
check.failLine: He rolls, and he keeps rolling, and your hull comes apart along the grain.

phases.dialogueLine: You want the Don? Then come through me. Nothing you carry gets past me.

preFightDialogue.speaker: narrator
preFightDialogue.text: The keeper stands behind a counter of run-out cannon, one hand resting on a small brass box.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: I'm impressed. But I figured as much. I know your every move, regardless.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: You're a quartermaster, not a fortune teller. And I'm sorry to say that every one of your goons said the same thing and met a similar fate.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: That box, captain. That's what's tracking us...

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: We're gonna have to destroy that.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: It's far too late. I've already reported your position to the Don. He knows what's coming.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: But I've already made the promise that he won't be seeing you at all.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: You can track us, but that's not gonna help you here. Ready up captain!

preFightDialogue.speaker: narrator
preFightDialogue.text: Past the harbor wall the Coffers open up. A large galleon is already coming about to meet you.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Far enough, captain. Nobody sails into the Coffers uninvited and lives to tell the tale.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Ruse...

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Admiral Ruse, to you. You lot have seemed to cause quite the stir. Mighty bold of you to show up to the Finndicate's coffers all on your own.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Mighty bold of you to steal from the weak. Does the Finndicate not have enough at their disposal?

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: The Finndicate's mission goes far beyond your own.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: And what would that be?

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: That's way above your pay grade.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Well then it's time to claim our paycheck here, Ruse.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: That's Admiral Ruse, to you.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Sorry, that title's above your pay grade.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Brace yourself!

_finnText: FINN'S WORDS, EDITED IN THE PORT (Kong, 2026-10-16): laid over the job or story beat with that id (core/rules.gd _finn_text); docs/finn-script.md is the read-through.

lines.text: Ok, looks like we have a new captain on the waters.
Name's Finn. I've been fishing these waters for years.
You're not gonna get rich in the Shallows, trust me. But you gotta start somewhere.
A job you say? Let's see what you're made of...

q1.give: Hmm...why don't you try getting me 8 catches from the Shallows. Make sure you got enough bait...and try and hit those perfect catches!
q1.waiting: Not quite there yet, captain. Eight is what I need.
q1.done: Well well...so you did it. I knew you would.

lines.text: Already ready for some more? An eager fisher, aren't ya?
You've got quick hands. But quick hands don't mean anything without the right equipment. Make sure you're always getting the best gear to help with your catches.

q2.give: I'll tell you this much...anyone can land a fish in the Shallows. Let me see you land four perfect catches.
q2.done: Four perfect catches. Can't get 4 of these by accident, well done.

lines.text: The mainland is beautiful isn't it? So many hard workers keeping everything running.
Be sure to check out the Tavern to hear all the gossip around.
I don't gossip...I've got far more important things to do.
Life's more than just doubloons, but doesn't hurt to have more am I right? Gotta keep the market happy.

q3.give: Next one's a grind, my good friend. I'd like to see you catch 15 in the Shallows. No better practice than catching a bunch.
q3.waiting: Not seeing 15 here, buddy. Let's see you hit 15 first.

p1.give: This next job's a bit trickier...I need a fish here in the Shallows...I forgot what it's called. All I know is that it "can live over 40 years and remember the location of its food sources." Maybe you've caught one before? Check your log, then bring me a fresh one.
p1.waiting: Nah not that one. Try again.
p1.done: That's it! The Common Carp. Did it feel common?

lines.text: Have you checked out the Den on the Mainland yet?
I haven't seen too many people make it out better than before they went in...but maybe you'll be different.
Money's no issue for me anymore. But I get the appeal.
When I'm done with a long day of fishing, sometimes I'll go to the Parlor.
You get humbled there. So many things to know about the sea.
Even for someone as experienced as myself.
All this to say...there's so much more to explore out there. Be sure you're checking out everything on your map. We didn't get free maps back in the day.

q21.give: Even the Shallows has some uncommon fish. Go and catch me two uncommon or rarer fish.
q21.waiting: These don't fit the bill...try again, captain.
q21.done: That's what I'm talking about. These will sell for a pretty penny...well for the Shallows at least.

lines.text: The Chart Room is interesting.
Used to just be a place where you charted maps. Now it seems like it appeals to the younger generation.
I've charted this whole sea. I always have the need to know where everything is.

q22.give: Let's really test your skill. Land 3 perfect catches in a row. And then come back to me.
q22.waiting: Not quite there, yet. Keep practicing.
q22.done: Your skills are growing. That's what I'm talking about.

lines.text: Have you gotten any crates yet? Those are always fun to pull up out the water.
I've collected thousands over the years.
You can get some of the coolest items from them...

p2.give: The days go by so quickly. Catch me 3 fish in the Shallows at dawn or dusk...some may call it golden hour.
p2.waiting: Make sure you're catching it at the right time...not seeing you did that yet.
p2.done: Isn't it just the most beautiful time to reel these in? Great work.

lines.text: You're starting to outgrow these waters...
Are you talking to the others out there as well?
I'm not about making friends...but I will say cozying up to certain individuals has its benefits.

q23.label: Land 25 fish in the Shallows
q23.give: Your final task in the Shallows...catch me 25 fish. Should be easy peasy for you now.
q23.done: That's it. My my, how far you've come!

lines.text: Ready for the next zone are we?
The Open Waters...home to more fish.
The deeper you go, the more difficult the catch. But you'll be racking up experience and doubloons faster too.

q4.give: We're no longer in the Shallows, baby. Let's see you land 10 fish in the new Open Waters.
q4.waiting: Didn't see you catch 10 fish in the Open Waters yet. Come back when you have.
q4.done: How did that feel? Isn't it a great feeling getting out further into the sea?
q4.gated: Not ready for the Open Waters just yet, captain.

lines.text: Have you started filling in your log? I'd say it's worthwhile to try...
Make sure you're checking out the tackle shop for new rods. Each rod has its own unique effect. But the best rods...you'll have to discover those yourself.

q5.label: Land 4 perfect catches in a row in Open Waters
q5.give: Skill check! Let's see you catch 4 perfect catches in a row in the Open Waters.
q5.waiting: Didn't see the 4 catches in a row there yet, buddy. Let me know once you got it.
q5.done: Four straight perfects. That is something to celebrate!

p3.label: Land the fish he describes, in Open Waters
p3.give: I forget the name again...get me a fish in these Open Waters...ugh what are they called again...all I know is they can't stop swimming or they'll suffocate, since they breathe only by moving forward through the water.
p3.done: That's the one. The Atlantic Mackerel! You're sure good at following directions.

lines.text: These waters have a charm to them.
Although...the deeper you go, the longer you'll wait for your catch usually.
Better bait will always help with getting those fish to bite more easily though.
Even out in the Open Waters, there's a lot to discover.
Have you gone north through the Anchorage yet?
Me? I prefer the quiet and calm in the southern seas. Fishing is more my cup of tea. Although, back in the day, I went on quite a few expeditions myself.

q6.give: Catch me three rare fish or better in the Open Waters.
q6.waiting: Not rare enough...come back when you've got them.
q6.done: Great catches! You're turning out to be quite the angler, if I do say so myself.

lines.text: Your shipyard gives you a ton of upgrades for your boats.
Make sure you upgrade often. Don't let your doubloon earnings go to waste.
I like a speedy boat. But having a big fish hold to catch more fish is always good too.
Trust me...there's some biiiig fish out there.

q24.give: Let's see if you can get 10 perfect catches in the Open Waters.
q24.waiting: Not quite there yet. Come back when you've hit 10.
q24.done: Perfects are becoming your new normal. Very nice!

lines.text: You'll catch certain fish better at different times in the day.
It's never fun sailing in a storm...but fishing in the storm might also help you catch certain types of fish.

p4.label: Land an epic or better in Open Waters
p4.give: There are rare fish...then there are epic fish. Go and catch me an epic or rarer fish in the Open Waters.
p4.done: Now that's what I'm talking about.
